findings.title: Sign-out skips the unsaved-changes guard and drops pending line saves
findings.evidence: Both sign-out buttons call `logout` directly (`onClick={logout}`). `logout()` POSTs /api/auth/logout and calls setUser(null), which changes `shellKey` (App.tsx:66) and remounts the whole shell. `confirmDiscard()` (unsavedGuard.tsx) is never consulted. Every other exit (links, Back/Forward, reload, Escape, Cancel, the layout switch) goes through the leave registry. The remount also runs useLineSaveQueue's unmount cleanup `q.sendPending()` after the server has already revoked the cookies. Those writes 401, the refresh fails, and `sendPending` swallows the error (`.catch(() => {})`, useLineSaveQueue.ts:96).
findings.failure_scenario: A manager edits a PO, inventory item or sell order (dirty, guard registered) and clicks the sidebar sign-out icon next to their name. The edits are discarded with no prompt. In Review mode, ticking a line and signing out within the 400 ms debounce sends that tick without a session, and it is lost silently: the count never reaches the server.
findings.proposed_fix: Route both sign-out buttons through `confirmDiscard()` before `logout()`. In logout, flush session-owned write queues (or await a registered 'beforeLogout' hook) before POST /api/auth/logout, so pending writes go out while the cookie is still valid.
findings.regression_test: Render a shell with a dirty editor (registered holder), click sign-out, reject the prompt: the user stays signed in and the edits remain. Accept the prompt: logout proceeds. For the queue, save a check, call logout before 400 ms, and assert the PATCH is sent before POST /api/auth/logout.

findings.title: Module-level session state survives the identity remount (FE-01 residual)
findings.evidence: FE-01 was fixed by keying the shell on `user?.id`, which resets React state only. `clearLocalAuthState` resets lookups, workspace, warehouses and aiModels. It does not touch the `listMemory` Map (`usePersisted`), the accounting review-count snapshot, the Reddit-leads attention snapshot, or the pending sell-order prefill. `usePersisted` holds `desktop.inventory.selected` and `desktop.inventory.selectedRows`, a Map of full InventoryRow objects. It also holds the orders, payments and shipping search text, filters, the assignee filter and the open internal-transaction id.
findings.failure_scenario: Manager A selects 40 inventory lots, with a search and filters set, then signs out. Manager B signs in on the same tab. Inventory opens with A's selection already in the floating bar (resolved from A's remembered row snapshots, even ones not in B's list) and A's search applied. B can create a sell order or transfer from a selection they didn't make. B's sidebar also shows A's review-count and leads badges until the first re-read lands.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a session-reset registry: modules register a reset callback and `clearLocalAuthState` calls them all. Register listMemory `mem.clear()`, the badge counters, sellOrderPrefill and boxCheck entryAnswer. Alternatively, key listMemory entries by user id.
findings.regression_test: Set usePersisted values and stash a prefill, run the logout path, and assert listMemory is empty, the prefill is null and the badge snapshots are 0.

findings.title: Module caches have no generation check, so a stale in-flight load repopulates after reset
findings.evidence: `reset*()` sets `inflight = null` and clears the data. The still-running IIFE then writes `cached = data.items` or `loaded = true` and fills the arrays when its response lands. Nothing tells it a reset happened in between. warehouses.ts says resetWarehouses() runs after every WarehousesPanel write precisely to drop a stale copy.
findings.failure_scenario: A loadWarehouses() GET is in flight (any of the ten consumers mounting). The manager archives a warehouse, WarehousesPanel calls resetWarehouses(), and then the older GET lands. It sets `cached` to the pre-archive list, and the archived warehouse stays in every picker until reload. The same race with logout leaves lookups `loaded=true`, so the next login skips the refetch.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep a module `generation` counter that reset() increments. The loader captures it and only commits if it is unchanged.
findings.regression_test: Start loadWarehouses() with a deferred fetch, call resetWarehouses(), resolve the old fetch, and assert the next loadWarehouses() issues a new GET.

findings.title: Document language is not set from the profile; Combobox toggle label is hardcoded English
findings.evidence: `document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', l)` runs only inside setLang (an explicit switch). Initialising `lang` from `user.language`, or from the device via follow-system, never updates `<html lang="en">`. Combobox's toggle uses `aria-label={open ? 'Close options' : 'Open options'}` with no t() call. The i18n coverage test only catches t() literals, so neither gap is caught.
findings.failure_scenario: A zh-profile user reloads, and every page renders Chinese under lang="en". Screen readers read it with an English voice, browsers offer to translate 'English', and CJK glyph and font fallback is chosen for the wrong locale. Chinese users of every Combobox hear an English control name.
findings.proposed_fix: Set documentElement.lang in an effect keyed on `lang` inside LangProvider. Add comboboxOpen/comboboxClose keys.
findings.regression_test: LangProvider with a zh user: document.documentElement.lang === 'zh' after the profile resolves. Combobox under zh: the toggle aria-label comes from the zh table.

notes: Depth was risk-weighted, not exhaustive. Read in full: session/auth/API client, preferences, caches, focus-trap/modal, unsaved guard, save queue, route launch code, and the i18n provider and tests. The rest of the 304-file list was covered by targeted scans, not line-by-line reads: module-level mutable state across lib/components, every literal t() key against the en table (no undefined literal keys; prefix-built keys like acctMethod_/asStatus_ were not enumerated against their enums), hardcoded English attributes and text in components and shared pages, async effects in the pickers (all have alive guards), and the logout call sites. CSS files, the bulk of i18n.zh.ts, coordinator/fleet/facebookPool/tracker client libs, OrderDetail.tsx, SubmitForm.tsx, Shipping.tsx and most pure-helper tests were not read line by line. No repro tests written. Nothing was run beyond static scans; the baseline shows frontend-test rc=0 and typecheck rc=0. No live resources touched.
